pure_criterion.scope: Characteristic-zero fields,all constant-coefficient operators Lambda=Delta_A+D_b+c of order<=2,arbitrary polynomial phase
pure_criterion.nonzero_constant_symbol: c!=0 makes Lambda invertible on bounded-degree polynomials;purity forces P0
pure_criterion.zero_constant_symbol: Firstn+1 pure polynomial identities iff (A HessP)^n=0 and D_bP=0 iff all pure identities
pure_criterion.trace_mechanism: The Laurent heat-log has sdegree<=1;the prefix gives TrJ^k=0 for k2..n+1 and TrJ+D_bP=0
pure_criterion.missing_first_trace: An invertible Vandermonde matrix on the distinct nonzero eigenvalues forces all their positive integer multiplicities to vanish,a contradiction inchar0
pure_criterion.not_claimed: Optimal prefix length,Gaussian origin moments or ordinary nonreduced ideal equality

mixed_reduction.equivalence: On the nontrivial pure branch,Lambda safety iff Delta_A safety iff polynomial scalar U iff polynomial inverse of x-tAgradientP
mixed_reduction.sharp_caution: For Lambda=d_x^2+d_y,P=x,Q=y^d,the marked index2d equals((2d)!)^2/d!,and the full mixed slope2 is sharp;the quadratic part alone has slope1

drift_quotient.nonzero_b: Choose D_b=d_y;purity forces P independent ofy;the scalar U is the quotient quadratic potential in n-1 variables
drift_quotient.qualitative_equivalence: Every original multiplier is safe iff the quotient quadratic pair is safe;cross terms change marked values but not U
drift_quotient.dimension_relation: Least failing dimension with nonzero drift equals least homogeneous-quadratic failing dimension plus1,including infinity;degree bounds and homogeneous-phase restrictions are preserved

closed_uniform_family.closed_union: P0 or (c0,D_bP0,and (A,P) in the prior closed quadratic safe locus)
closed_uniform_family.covers: All A,b,c,including rank changes,b becomingzero and c becomingnonzero
closed_uniform_family.chain: Increasing closed field cutoff loci stabilize at the stated bound

cubic_order_minimum.positive: Every pure degree<=3 phase is safe for every operator of order<=2 in every dimension,without homogeneity restrictions
cubic_order_minimum.negative: DVG1 retains an independently replayed homogeneous cubic failure for an order-three operator in five variables
cubic_order_minimum.consequence: Every obstruction-preserving lift of that cubic to order<=2 must raise phase degree,even when lower-order terms are permitted
